description: Side-by-side markdown editor with live preview. Adopts the authored textarea and composes markdown-viewer.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Textarea placeholder; overrides the textarea's own. No default placeholder

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: Textarea rows; overrides the textarea's own rows

attributes.name: highlight
attributes.description: Pass highlight attribute to the preview viewer (markdown-viewer:highlight per code block)

attributes.name: data-tab-indent
attributes.description: Tab inserts two spaces instead of moving focus. Escape then Tab moves focus; Shift+Tab is never captured. Read at upgrade

attributes.name: data-auto-mermaid
attributes.description: Upgrade ```mermaid fences in the live preview to diagram-wc (loads the mermaid bridge)

attributes.name: data-theme
attributes.description: Theme propagated to the preview pane

attributes.name: data-label-source
attributes.description: Accessible name of the source pane; also names the textarea when nothing else does

attributes.name: data-label-preview
attributes.description: Accessible name of the preview pane

attributes.name: data-label-tab-hint
attributes.default: Tab inserts spaces. Press Escape, then Tab, to move focus.
attributes.description: Description read with the textarea when data-tab-indent is set

childAttributes.name: name
childAttributes.description: Form field name. Goes on the textarea, so the value submits with or without JavaScript

childAttributes.name: required
childAttributes.description: Native constraint validation (also minlength, maxlength, readonly, form)

childAttributes.name: id
childAttributes.description: Kept on upgrade, so a <label for> keeps naming the textarea

childAttributes.name: dir
childAttributes.description: Base direction for the source and the preview (default auto)

structure.description: The editable source. Adopted and moved into the source pane with its attributes; created when absent

events.name: markdown-editor:input
events.description: Fired on each keystroke. Bubbles, composed

events.name: markdown-editor:change
events.description: source "user": on blur after the content changed. source "api": when .value is assigned (the next blur does not repeat it). Not fired by form reset. Bubbles, composed

properties.name: value
properties.description: Get/set the markdown. Setting updates the preview immediately and fires markdown-editor:change with source "api"

properties.name: textarea
properties.description: The backing textarea: the authored one when provided. Stable across reconnects
